description: A bought-off drawback CAN be taken again, and the retake contributes its full AP. Before D-GH-2026-08-06-buyoff-keyed-by-event, activeEvents() keyed its boughtOff map by drawback VALUE, so any buyoff for a drawback suppressed EVERY buy of that value forever — including ones taken AFTER the buyoff. The retake was silently dropped from the build and never counted toward earned AP, with no warning. This fixture is the task's own repro: buy Asthmatic (+2 AP), buy it off (-6 AP, 3x refund), take Asthmatic again. Only the FIRST purchase is cancelled by the buyoff (FIFO match); the retake stays open. Expected: the build holds Asthmatic (compute().total = -2, the one active drawback's refund line); economy() reads earned=202 (200 award + 2 for the still-open retake only — the cancelled first purchase contributes nothing), spent=6 (the buyoff), available=196, drawbackEarned=2. Before the fix: build has NO Asthmatic, drawbackEarned=0.
